source.name: EverBank (news release): EverBank and the Jacksonville Jaguars Reach Pending Agreement for Stadium Naming-Rights Extension
source.quote: The home field of the Jacksonville Jaguars will remain EverBank Stadium through the end of the 2027 NFL season under a three-year naming-rights contract extension
source.note: from 2010: the release says 'EverBank first acquired the naming rights to the Jaguars' stadium in 2010 and signed a 10-year extension in 2014'.

note: Stadium naming rights: EverBank Stadium, through the 2027 NFL season (extension pending City of Jacksonville approval as of the 2024-05-17 release).
